messages.text: Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2

Desk or office works fine. It's ~166 W and about 40 dB, so roughly a quiet fan hum — audible in a silent room but not disruptive. It needs a bit of airflow around it and it puts out a little warmth, like a small space heater on low.

It's $369 right now (down from $449), 10 TH/s, ships October 3, 2026.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
